description: Three-Month Weather-Integrated Data Center Power Load Hourly Dataset is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Ali Bohluli Oskouei, Sara Eftekharnejad. "This dataset provides three months of hourly data center electric load profiles designed for dynamic load analysis, monitoring, and planning studies in power systems. The dataset contains six data center sites with meteorological context corresponding to Syracuse, New York, over the period from May 1, 2018, to July 31, 2018. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
